QuestInfo.name: Secure a New Route
QuestInfo.1: You need to take out the enemy camp, so the supply route can travel along a more direct path. \r\n#b(Since this is a battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You took out the enemy camp and improved the supply route!

1.0: Amazing! The enemy is withdrawing from their encampment!\r\n

yes.0: It's going to take some work to set up a supply route there, but I think we've got the manpower to do it.\r\n
yes.1: #bPiston#k's in the #bCommander Barracks#k waiting to speak with you about your next mission.\r\n
yes.2: Thanks to you, our people can set up a new supply route through there. You have my gratitude.\r\n
